messages:
julia: Quick sync — prepping a non-blocking cutover plan for EU->US active/active promotion for a subset of tenants (GDPR scoped). want to confirm operator responsibilities and which checks must be blocking vs async. no PII movement without explicit consent tag.

mike: +1. my read: steering traffic is non-blocking, but final state handoff (escrowed writes) must be gated. we should separate network cutover from data migration.

sophia: question: how do we mark tenants as 'consent-granted' in the routing plane? a header? tenant flag? need an invariant we can check quickly in proxy.

raj: propose a two-bit flag: tenant.meta.consent (yes|no) and tenant.meta.jurisdiction (EU|US|multi). routing checks short-circuit on consent=no -> block data move; consent=yes -> proceed. fast to evaluate.

emily: agree. but operators will need a rollback path if downstream observability spikes. we should have an automated pause and drain step.

infra-bot: deploy-canary: started canary for routing-rule v3 -> 10% traffic in eu-edge -> us-primary at 1715132200 :rocket:

mike: ops-role matrix suggestion:
- oncall: monitor latency/error surge and flip steering to origin
- infra-eng: run the escrow handoff job and validate checksum
- security: verify consent flag audit and KMS access logs
- product: sign off on subset selection

sophia: can we make the escrow job idempotent and resumable? last time a mid-job interruption caused double-inserts in downstream index.

raj: yep. suggested operator-run snippet:
```
# escrow handoff (idempotent)
for tenant in tenants_to_promote:
  if escrow_state[tenant] == "completed":
    continue
  run_handoff(tenant)  # writes a tombstone + resume token
  escrow_state[tenant] = "completed"
```

emily: on the non-blocking semantics: reads always prefer local-serving cached KV until escrow completes. writes for promoted tenants are forwarded to both locations with write-lease TTL=30s so we can observe divergence. if divergence > threshold -> automatic revert.

mike: divergence threshold proposal: 0.5% error rate OR 2000 ops unmatched in 5m window -> pause.

julia: security ask: ensure consent=true tenants have a signed consent event in audit log before we flip final flags. @sophia can you add that check to routing preflight?

sophia: will add. preflight will check: signed_consent_event && kms-seal present. rejecting preflight returns HTTP 409 and operator alert.

infra-bot: alert: preflight failed for tenant t-47 (no signed consent) at 1715132280

emily: action item: produce a short runbook snippet for oncall when escrow job stalls. include commands and what to inspect (handshake logs, kv-checksum, reverse-proxy counters).

raj: also we should capture billing effect: when steering is non-blocking but writes are mirrored, cost doubles for that tenant for the window. product needs to OK short-term cost bump.

mike: noted — I'll add cost annotation to the rollout ticket and set a budget guard.

julia: final: agree on meeting tomorrow to sign the operator checklist. owners: mike (ops), raj (handoff code), sophia (routing preflight), emily (runbook). I'll draft the checklist and post here. :white_check_mark:

sophia: ping @oncall when draft is up, please.

mike: thanks team. low-churn messages only in the channel while canary runs. we'll escalate to paging if thresholds cross. :thumbsup:
